Hymn 70: Sing Praise to Him
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Hans Georg Nägeli
Lyricist/Text Author: Robert Robinson
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 70 titled "Sing Praise to Him" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Hans Georg Nägeli and the lyrics were written by Robert Robinson.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
